messages:
Leah: Heads-up — NimbusHealth asking to route their demo traffic through ap-northeast-1 and do a short live demo next month. They want higher per-route throughput and IP allowlisting for their proxy. Also flagged a renewal discussion in ~6 weeks; they're price-sensitive.
Tom_net: OK. can you get their source IPs + preferred peering window? we need ASN/CIDR and the contact for peering LOA.
Leah: pinging them now. they sent preliminary info: src IPs 45.77.12.0/27, 203.119.0.0/26, and NAT 150.95.100.12. Demo target week: 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-14 (local JST mornings).
Sofia_se: current plan for them is 100 req/min per route. For a demo spike I'd suggest temporary 450 req/min and a dedicated route so KV cache affinity is stable. Also recommend warming prefix cache prior to demo.
Evan_csm: I'll own the renewal touchpoint — schedule a cost/throughput walkthrough + a short ROI one-pager. want to include perf numbers: p50/p95 for ap-northeast-1 from our last perf run.
Ravi_ops: ephemeral allowlist OK. propose TTL=10 days with auto-sunset 2026-05-24T05:00Z. we'll notify CS 48h before revoke. Tom, can infra apply the peering and pinned route then?
Tom_net: yep. will need a written ops contact + signed demo window for security. also confirm whether they want VPC peering or proxy peering.
Leah: confirmed: proxy peering (shared proxy) + ops contact infra@nimbushealth.ai. They've agreed to the demo window in writing and signed LOA attached to the ticket.
Sofia_se: pasting suggested route config so there's a single source of truth for infra ops:
```
route: /v1/chat/nimbus
region_pin: ap-northeast-1
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 450/min
kv_cache: { warmup: true, prefix_cache: true }
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 45.77.12.0/27
  - 203.119.0.0/26
  - 150.95.100.12/32
ephemeral_ttl_days: 10
auto_revoke_at: 2026-05-24T05:00Z
enablement_flag: "needs_cost_walkthrough"
notes: "Demo 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-14 JST mornings; CS to run post-demo feedback survey"
```
Tom_net: queued peering task once ticket attachments are in the ticket. change_id=chg_nh_20260510_01. setting up route pin and ACLs.
ops-bot: network-change: scheduled change for customer=nimbushealth, change_id=chg_nh_20260510_01, status=scheduled, exec_window=2026-05-09T22:00Z->2026-05-10T02:00Z UTC
Evan_csm: Awesome. I'll prep the cost walkthrough deck and a short survey (latency, error rates, perceived quality). can someone add a post-demo checklist for the CSM handoff?
Ravi_ops: Adding checklist item: "confirm revoke and collect post-demo metrics (p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost)". I'll set the auto-notify 48h before TTL expiry.
Leah: Thanks team 44aa. tagging @Sofia_se and @Evan_csm for post-demo follow-up.
